about: The source model of a Nikon ND2 file (format 3+): the elements a parser emits, the members of its lite-variant metadata it reads and checks, the quantities it derives, and the constraints a file must meet to have the ND2 convention's layout. A parser checks this schema while it parses; projections read a valid IR and check nothing. Kinds of members are those of spec/virtualize/nd2.md §2.2: number, integer, color, flag, string, object, list, and members (an object or a list, read as its member values).

elements.about: The IR of an ND2 file. Names in angle brackets are variables; `run` marks where a parser folds consecutive identically shaped siblings into one run.

chunks/<name>.about: each chunk of the map (the last record of a name) that is not a frame; named by its name read as text

children.name: bytes[n]
children.lv: struct (LV records in the source) or derived (transform nd2-lv-zlib: a compressed record, its LV records in the derived bytes): when the chunk decodes
children.xml: derived (transform xml-variant): the variant element, its elements as structs and its value attributes as values of type xml:<runtype>
children.data: bytes[d]: when the chunk does not decode

lv records.scalar: value {lv:u1,k:u1,name:bytes[2k],v:<type>} named by the record's exact name
lv records.level: struct: header {lv:u1,k:u1,name:bytes[2k],count:<u4,length:<u8}, its records, table bytes[8c]

frames/<f>.about: each chunk ImageDataSeq|<f>! (f decimal without leading zeros)

children.name: bytes[n]
children.pixels: data (placed frames): geometry, codec, recipe (src, or rows for padded rows)
children.trailing: bytes (placed uncompressed frames with more data than their pixels)
children.data: bytes[d] (frames the image does not place)

node.about: An experiment node. Every node of the tree is checked, whether or not the flattening visits it.

loops.about: uLoopPars by eType (read only when uLoopPars is present). count: the loop's count; a node of count 0 is skipped. valid: a member list filtered by a validity list (absent: all valid; else the i-th member is valid when the i-th flag exists and is true).

constraints.message: the time loop's count is more than 2^53 - 1
the z step is not finite

node.flatten: Nodes are visited depth first, each before its children; the root has depth 0, a node's children are one deeper, except a spectral node's, which have its depth. A node without uLoopPars or of count 0 is skipped with its children; a spectral node is skipped and its children visited; any other node's loop is appended when the list is empty or the last loop is shallower, replaces the last loop when that has its depth and kind and a smaller count, and is otherwise dropped; its children are visited either way.

constraints.message: image width and height must be at least 1, and components from 1 to 1024
lossy ND2 compression is not supported
tiled ND2 frames are not supported
uiWidthBytes is less than a row
compressed frames with padded rows are not supported
more than 2^16 positions, or more than 2^20 positions x components
a placed frame's chunk header is not an ND2 chunk header within the file
a compressed frame has no data
a frame's chunk header differs in name length from the first frame's
a frame's chunk is too short for its pixels
a frame's pixels lie outside the file
a stage position is not finite

about_builtins: Quantities the checker computes by name: loops (the flattening above, from the experiment), loops_product (the product of their counts), loops_distinct (no two loops of one kind), p_count, t_scale, z_scale (the position loop's count, the time loop's period, the z loop's step; absent without the loop), placed.* (over the placed frames, the frames f < N the chunk map names: count, unreadable (headers that are not an ND2 chunk header within the file, or at an offset or with a length past max_safe), min_name, max_name, min_data, max_pixels_end), finite_translations (each image's stage translation, spec/virtualize/nd2.md §4.3, is finite), size (the file's).
